main_text.p: eidii reum tanquam suaforem & homicidæ fautorem atque receptorem statuunt.

Eo iudicio omnia eius bona atque prædia Regis fisco adiudicata sunt. Ipseque a Regis iudicibus citatus vt coram eis in Regio foro capitis causam diceret. Qua a Cantuariensi Archiepiscopo ac nonnullis Cantuariensis prouinciæ suffraganeis comitatus accessit ad tribunal Regium. Cumq; declinatoris exceptionibus subterfugere Laicorum iudicium non potuit, respondit se antedicti homicidii nequaquam conscium, nec contulisse...

page.notes: The page is a dense Latin text (Matthew Parker / Britannia Sacra style, Ecclesiastical history). Only the opening lines were legible enough to copy reliably; the remainder of the two columns and the marginal notes could not be read with confidence and are not transcribed in full. Right-margin marginal notes (e.g. "Sine Eyrsk", "Arch.") are partly illegible.
